completion_reason: Three material validation and failure-policy decisions remain unresolved.

questions.label: Acceptance proof
questions.context: The plan needs a clear standard for declaring the streamlined product ready.
questions.question: What proof is required before acceptance?

choices.text: Existing checks plus human validation of all six tabs and critical failure recovery.
Existing automated checks plus happy-path validation only.
Manual review of the six tabs without formal recovery tests.

questions.label: Lease failures
questions.context: Provider crashes and expired atomic leases can cause duplicate execution or lost work.
questions.question: How should failed leased runs recover?

choices.text: Retry with idempotency keys, then stop after a bounded limit for manual review.
Retry indefinitely until a provider succeeds.
Fail immediately and require manual restart.
Attempt exactly-once execution with no duplicate tolerance.

questions.label: Approval scope
questions.context: Approval-gated stages need an auditable rule for what an approval authorizes.
questions.question: What should each approval bind to?

choices.text: The immutable stage revision, inputs, outputs, and validation evidence; any change invalidates approval.
The stage revision only; changed inputs or outputs retain approval.
The whole workflow version with one shared approval.
The conversation request without artifact-level binding.
